knowledge.name: Bundled synthetic sales records
knowledge.detail: Fixed product, ownership, usage, buying-signal, pricing, margin, and budget records support deterministic review cases.

knowledge.name: Affinity and benchmark assumptions
knowledge.detail: Eight product-affinity rules and three segment benchmarks provide labeled response, cycle, and expansion assumptions.

knowledge.name: Operating rules and locked cases
knowledge.detail: Rules define four operations, evidence anchors, fail-closed routing, synthetic labels, and seller approval boundaries.

intelligence_processing.name: Product-gap opportunity scanning
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares owned products with affinity rules and presents usage, buying, and budget signals from the fixed snapshot.

intelligence_processing.name: Affinity assumption explanation
intelligence_processing.detail: Explains product relationships and segment benchmarks without treating modeled response or cycle values as observed performance.

intelligence_processing.name: Prioritized recommendation drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks reviewable product options by affinity and calculates illustrative weighted value without selecting or approving an offer.

intelligence_processing.name: Portfolio value scenario modeling
intelligence_processing.detail: Aggregates potential ARR, weighted value, and margin scenarios while avoiding conversion, forecast, or realized-revenue claims.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio seller experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language review for sales operations, enablement, and sales leaders through an unpublished Draft agent.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file CrossSellingAgent locally with allow-listed customer IDs and a synthetic-only data source.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-first seller review
clients_user_interface.detail: Shows source-backed gaps, assumptions, calculations, and a draft engagement plan for authorized seller review only.

management_reporting.name: Cross-Sell Opportunity Scan
management_reporting.detail: Reports customer context, current products, usage and buying signals, budget timing, and synthetic product gaps.

management_reporting.name: Product Affinity Matrix
management_reporting.detail: Reports packaged product relationships, response assumptions, cycle assumptions, and segment expansion benchmarks.

management_reporting.name: Prioritized Recommendations
management_reporting.detail: Reports ranked options, synthetic assumptions, illustrative weighted values, and a draft engagement plan not sent.

management_reporting.name: Synthetic Cross-Sell Value Scenario
management_reporting.detail: Reports portfolio opportunity counts and modeled ARR, weighted, and margin totals without outcome or forecast claims.

tools.name: Portable CrossSellingAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python agent exposes four deterministic read-only operations with bundled synthetic evidence and no credentials.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the conversational package, uploaded knowledge, and four operation behaviors; validated artifacts remain Draft.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
tools.detail: Approved production seam for account context; it is not connected and no CRM record is read or changed in the package.

tools.name: Product entitlement and usage source
tools.detail: Approved production seam for ownership and usage evidence; current operation routing uses only fixed synthetic records.

tools.name: Approved recommendation rules
tools.detail: Governed production seam for affinity logic; current affinity and benchmark values are bundled scenario assumptions.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Supports seller and enablement review after deployment; the agent never sends, schedules, or automates outreach.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The host model interprets requests and presents bounded results while deterministic calculations remain authoritative.

supporting_features.name: Four explicit operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes opportunity scan, product affinity, recommendation drafting, and revenue scenario requests through a fixed enum.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only fail-closed routing
supporting_features.detail: Rejects unsupported sources, operations, and customer identifiers rather than browsing, enriching, or inventing evidence.

supporting_features.name: Scenario and evidence labeling
supporting_features.detail: Labels exact names, prices, ARR, scores, rates, timing, margins, and weighted values as synthetic planning evidence.

supporting_features.name: Seller review and approval gate
supporting_features.detail: Authorized account, sales, pricing, and compliance reviewers validate evidence, consent, fit, messaging, and action.

supporting_features.name: No autonomous outreach boundary
supporting_features.detail: Never sends or schedules outreach, creates leads or opportunities, changes CRM, applies pricing, quotes, or transacts.

supporting_features.name: Locked four-case validation
supporting_features.detail: One persona-language case per operation verifies deterministic anchors and prohibits outreach or CRM-update claims.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Copilot Studio artifacts remain unpublished Drafts; publish and all external actions require separate user approval.
